description: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/chat.rs, message.rs, space.rs, ban.rs, contact.rs, emoji.rs, presence.rs, position.rs, invite.rs: all call 'serde_json::to_value(&set_err).unwrap_or_else(|e| json!(...))' inline for every notCreated/notUpdated/notDestroyed entry. crate-jmap-mail-server/src/helpers.rs extracted this pattern into a 'set_error_value' helper and uses it everywhere. The chat-server crate has its own helpers.rs but it does not export this helper. The repeated inline pattern is a DRY violation that will drift. The chat-server should add an equivalent helper, as the mail-server did.
title: chat-server /set handlers: serde_json::to_value(&set_err).unwrap_or_else vs mail-server set_error_value helper
